fact: Decree D/2025/052 of 14 April 2025 sets the rules for the RNPP, states it is fed by the RNEC, requires deaths to be taken into the RNPP immediately, and requires anyone requesting a public or private service to present their NPI.
title: Décret fixant les modalités d’inscription et de tenue du registre national des personnes physiques (RNPP)
